Container.Name: nginx-ui
Container.Overview: Official standalone Nginx UI template with bundled Nginx. Nginx configuration, Nginx UI data, and web content are persisted on the Unraid array.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: nginx reverse proxy web server certificate
Container.Requires: At least 256 MiB of free persistent storage is recommended.

Config.Name: WebUI HTTP port
Config.Description: HTTP port used to open Nginx UI.

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: HTTPS port served by the bundled Nginx instance.

Config.Name: Nginx UI appdata
Config.Description: Nginx UI database, settings, and startup secret.

Config.Name: Web root
Config.Description: Static website content managed by Nginx UI.

Config.Name: Disable container self-update
Config.Description: Unraid manages image updates; keep the Docker socket disabled.
